226 AM PST Tue Nov 10 2026

.Synopsis for the far Southern CA coast...
At 1 AM, a 1024 mb high was 600 nautical miles west of Ensenada,
Mexico, and extended northeast through far northern California
into central Idaho. A 1017 mb low over Santa Monica extended
southeast along the Baja California coast. Northeast offshore 
flow during nights and mornings will alternate with northwest 
onshore flow during afternoons and evenings through Thursday. 
Westerly winds and seas increase for late Friday into Saturday, 
which could generate hazardous conditions.
